from optimizerllm import ContextOptimizer, CompressionMode

SEP = "\\n" + "="*70

# ─── TEST 5: DUPLICATE DETECTION ─────────────────────────────────────────────
print\(SEP\)
print\("TEST 5: DUPLICATE DETECTION  \(same doc injected 3x by different sources\)"\)
print\(SEP\)

same_content = "The mitochondria is the powerhouse of the cell."

opt = ContextOptimizer\(provider="openai", model="gpt-4o", mode=CompressionMode.CONSERVATIVE\)
result = opt.optimize\(
    system="You are a biology tutor.",
    documents=[same_content, same_content, same_content, "DNA carries genetic information."],
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Tell me about cells."}],
\)

print\(result.summary\(\)\)
print\(f"\\nDuplicates removed: {sum\(1 for r in result.telemetry.blocks_removed if 'duplicate' in r.reason\)}"\)
print\(f"Final doc blocks in output: {sum\(1 for b in result.blocks if b.block_type.value == 'retrieved_doc'\)}"\)


# ─── TEST 6: TIGHT BUDGET — AGGRESSIVE MODE ───────────────────────────────────
print\(SEP\)
print\("TEST 6: TIGHT BUDGET  \(100 tokens max, flood of docs, aggressive mode\)"\)
print\(SEP\)

opt6 = ContextOptimizer\(
    provider="openai", model="gpt-4o",
    max_input_tokens=100, output_budget=20,
    mode=CompressionMode.AGGRESSIVE,
\)
result6 = opt6.optimize\(
    system="Answer concisely.",
    documents=[
        "Document about cats: cats are small carnivorous mammals.",
        "Document about dogs: dogs are domesticated descendants of wolves.",
        "Document about birds: birds are warm-blooded vertebrates.",
        "Document about fish: fish breathe through gills.",
        "Document about reptiles: reptiles are cold-blooded vertebrates.",
    ],
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Tell me about cats."}],
    query="cats mammals",
\)

print\(result6.summary\(\)\)
print\(f"\\nDropped blocks \({len\(result6.telemetry.blocks_removed\)}\):"\)
for r in result6.telemetry.blocks_removed:
    score = f"{r.score:.3f}" if r.score is not None else "  N/A"
    print\(f"  {r.block_type:20s} | {r.reason:35s} | score={score}"\)

print\(f"\\nKept in output \({len\(result6.rendered\)} messages\):"\)
for msg in result6.rendered:
    print\(f"  [{msg['role']:9s}] {msg['content'][:80]}"\)


# ─── TEST 7: ANTHROPIC FORMAT ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
print\(SEP\)
print\("TEST 7: ANTHROPIC FORMAT  \(system separated, cache_control hints injected\)"\)
print\(SEP\)

opt7 = ContextOptimizer\(
    provider="anthropic", model="claude-3-5-sonnet",
    max_input_tokens=8192, output_budget=1024,
    mode=CompressionMode.CONSERVATIVE,
    output_format="anthropic",
\)
result7 = opt7.optimize\(
    system="You are Claude, a helpful AI assistant made by Anthropic.",
    documents=["The Eiffel Tower is located in Paris, France. It was built in 1889."],
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Where is the Eiffel Tower?"}],
    query="Eiffel Tower location",
\)

print\(result7.summary\(\)\)
print\(f"\\nRendered keys: {list\(result7.rendered.keys\(\)\)}"\)
print\(f"System: {result7.rendered.get\('system', ''\)[:60]}"\)
print\(f"Messages \({len\(result7.rendered['messages']\)}\):"\)
for msg in result7.rendered['messages']:
    content = msg['content']
    if isinstance\(content, list\):
        # cache_control injected — show structure
        print\(f"  [{msg['role']}] \(list content with cache_control\)"\)
        for part in content:
            has_cc = 'cache_control' in part
            print\(f"    text='{part.get\('text',''\)[:50]}...'  cache_control={has_cc}"\)
    else:
        print\(f"  [{msg['role']}] {str\(content\)[:80]}"\)
